title: SAP Production Planning (PP)
subtitle: SAP PP
description:
Course Description:

SAP PP (Production Planning) is a core SAP ERP module designed to streamline and optimize production processes in manufacturing organizations. It helps companies with material requirements planning (MRP), capacity planning, production scheduling, shop floor execution, and integration with other SAP modules like MM (Materials Management), SD (Sales & Distribution), and QM (Quality Management).
A certification in SAP PP validates your expertise in handling end-to-end production processes, aligning resources efficiently, and ensuring smooth manufacturing workflows.

Key Features of Course Divine:
Collaboration with E‑Cell IIT Tirupati
1:1 Online Mentorship Platform
Credit-Based Certification
Live Classes Led by Industry Experts
Live, Real-World Projects
100% Placement Support
Potential Interview Training
Resume-Building Activities

Career Opportunities After SAP PP (Production Planning) Certified Course:
SAP PP Consultant
Production Planner
SAP Functional Analyst (PP/MM/SD integration)
Supply Chain Management Specialist
Manufacturing Process Analyst
SAP End-user in Production Departments

Essential Skills you will Develop SAP PP (Production Planning) Certified Course:
production workflows business processes
BOM, Work Centers, Routings, Production Versions
Material Requirement Planning (MRP)
capacity planning and scheduling
MM, SD, QM, PM

Tools Covered:
SAP ECC PP Module
SAP Fiori apps for PP
MRP Live in S/4HANA

Syllabus:

Module 1:
Introduction to SAP & Production Planning Overview of ERP & SAP Role of SAP PP in manufacturing Navigation in SAP GUI & Fiori Organizational units in SAP PP.

Module 2:
Organizational Structure Defining plants, storage locations, and work centers Production resources/tools Factory calendar setup.

Module 3:
Master Data in SAP PP Views, data relevant for PP single-level, multi-level, variant BOMs Capacities, formulas, costing, scheduling Operations, sequence, activity types, production versions.

Module 4:
Demand Management Planned Independent Requirements (PIRs) Make-to-Order (MTO) vs. Make-to-Stock (MTS) production Sales & Operations Planning (SOP) Forecasting techniques.

Module 5:
Material Requirement Planning (MRP) MRP concepts & types Lot sizing procedures MRP run (MD01, MD02, MD03) Stock/requirements list & MRP evaluation MRP Live in S/4HANA.

Module 6:
Production Order Management Creation of production orders Order release & scheduling Printing of order documents Goods issue, confirmations, goods receipt Order settlement & closure.

Module 7:
Capacity Planning & Scheduling Work center capacity planning Capacity requirements & leveling Detailed scheduling Handling bottlenecks in production.

Module 8:
Shop Floor Control & Execution Production order confirmations Backlashing of components Rework & scrap handling Monitoring production progress Integration with shop floor systems.

Module 9:
Integration with Other SAP Modules PP with MM (Materials Management) PP with SD (Sales & Distribution) PP with QM (Quality Management) PP with PM (Plant Maintenance) Impact of FI/CO on production.

Module 10:
Reporting & Analytics Standard SAP PP reports (production order reports, capacity reports) Work-in-progress (WIP) monitoring SAP PP Analytics with Fiori apps KPIs & dashboards in S/4HANA.

Industry Projects:
End-to-End Production Cycle in SAP PP
Configuring MRP for a plant
BOM & Routing setup for a product line
 
Who is this program for?
Working Professionals in Manufacturing & Supply Chain
SAP Consultants from Other Modules
Production & Operations Managers
Business Analysts & ERP Specialists
Entrepreneurs & Plant Supervisors

title: SAP Financial Accounting and Controlling  (FICO)
subtitle: SAP FICO
description:
Description

Course Description:
The SAP FICO (Financial Accounting and Controlling) Certified Course is designed to provide comprehensive knowledge of financial management and controlling processes in SAP ERP. It equips learners with hands-on experience in configuring and managing financial accounting (FI) and controlling (CO) modules, enabling professionals to streamline financial transactions, reporting, and decision-making in enterprises. This course is ideal for individuals aspiring to build careers in finance, ERP systems, and SAP consultancy.

Key Features of Course Divine:
Collaboration with E‑Cell IIT Tirupati
1:1 Online Mentorship Platform
Credit-Based Certification
Live Classes Led by Industry Experts
Live, Real-World Projects
100% Placement Support
Potential Interview Training
Resume-Building Activities

Career Opportunities After SAP Modules (FICO) Financial Accounting and Controlling Certified Course:
SAP FICO Consultant
SAP Financial Analyst
Accounts Payable/Receivable Specialist
SAP ERP Finance Manager
Internal Auditor / Compliance Specialist
Business Process Analyst
ERP Functional Consultant

Essential Skills you will Develop SAP Modules (FICO) Financial Accounting and Controlling Certified Course:
Financial accounting and reporting in SAP
Controlling and cost center management
SAP system navigation and configuration
Data reconciliation between FI and CO modules
Financial closing and period-end activities
Asset accounting and depreciation handling
Hands-on SAP ERP financial transaction management

Tools Covered:
SAP ERP Central Component (SAP ECC)
SAP S/4HANA Finance
SAP GUI (Graphical User Interface)
SAP Fiori (for simplified user experience)
Reporting tools (SAP Reports, Queries, and Analysis)

Syllabus:

Module 1: Introduction to SAP & ERP Financial Systems Overview of ERP & SAP Introduction to SAP FICO Module Enterprise structure in SAP.

Module 2: General Ledger Accounting (FI-GL) Chart of accounts configuration Posting transactions Document splitting and reconciliation.

Module 3: Accounts Payable (FI-AP) Vendor master data management Invoice posting, payment processes Automatic payment program.

Module 4: Accounts Receivable (FI-AR) Customer master data Incoming payments, dunning process Credit management.

Module 5: Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Asset master data Acquisition, depreciation, retirement Asset transfer and reporting.

Module 6: Bank Accounting (FI-Bank) Bank master records Cash journal, electronic bank statement Bank reconciliation.

Module 7: Controlling (CO) Basics Cost element & cost center accounting Internal orders Activity-based costing.

Module 8: Profitability Analysis (CO-PA) Profit centers & segments Profitability reporting Contribution margin analysis.

Module 9: Integration of FI and CO Modules Cross-module transaction flow FI-CO reconciliation process Period-end closing activities.

Module 10: SAP Reporting & End User Activities Financial statement versions Reporting tools in SAP FICO Real-time project case studies.

Industry Projects:
Configuring financial accounting for a simulated company
Implementing accounts payable/receivable processes
Setting up asset accounting with depreciation run
Preparing financial reports & cost center analysis
SAP FICO integration with MM & SD modules

 Who is this program for?
Finance and accounting professionals
Chartered Accountants (CA), Cost Accountants, MBA Finance students
ERP consultants looking to specialize in SAP
Graduates seeking careers in SAP & enterprise finance systems

title: SAP  Materials Management(MM)
subtitle: SAP MM
description:
The SAP Materials Management  is a crucial module within the SAP ERP system that manages an organization’s material flows, from procurement to inventory. It handles processes like purchasing, inventory management, material valuation, and invoice verification, working in conjunction with other SAP modules like Sales and Distribution (SD), Production Planning (PP), and Finance and Controlling (FICO).

Key Features of Course Divine:
Collaboration with E‑Cell IIT Tirupati
1:1 Online Mentorship Platform
Credit-Based Certification
Live Classes Led by Industry Experts
Live, Real-World Projects
100% Placement Support

Resume-Building Activities

Career Opportunities After  SAP MM Materials Management:
Procurement Specialist
Inventory Manager
Supply Chain Analyst
SAP End-User
Logistics Coordinator
Warehouse Operations Manager
SAP Support Analyst

Essentials Skills You will Develop SAP MM Materials Management:
Procurement Process Mastery
Inventory Management

Material Requirement Planning

Tools Covered:
SAP ERP Central Component (SAP ECC)
Core SAP system for MM module operations.
SAP S/4HANA
Latest SAP platform with real-time data processing for MM.
SAP GUI (Graphical User Interface)
User interface to access SAP MM functionalities.

Syllbus:

Module 1: Introduction to SAP & ERP Introduction to ERP systems Overview of SAP & SAP Modules SAP MM role in business processes Navigation in SAP GUI Basic organizational structure in SAP (Client, Company Code, Plant, Storage Location).

Module 2: Master Data in SAP MM Material Master (creation, views, maintenance)
Vendor Master (Central, Purchasing, Accounting views) Purchasing Info Records
Source List Quota Arrangement.

Module 3: Procurement Process Basic procurement cycle (PR to PO to GR to IR)
Purchase Requisition (PR) creation & approval Request for Quotation (RFQ) & Quotation processing Purchase Order (PO) processing Goods Receipt (GR) process
Invoice Verification (MIRO) Automatic PO creation.

Module 4: Inventory Management Goods Movements (101, 102, 122, etc.) Stock Types (Unrestricted, Blocked, Quality) Transfer postings & Stock transfers Reservations and Physical Inventory Movement Types & Stock Overview.

Module 5: Valuation & Account Determination Material Valuation (Standard, Moving Average) Split Valuation Price Control (S and V) Automatic Account Determination (OBYC) Valuation Classes and Grouping.

Module 6: External Services Management (ESM) Service Master Data Service Entry Sheet (SES) Purchase Order for services Acceptance and Invoicing.

Module 7: Special Procurement Types Consignment Process Subcontracting Stock Transport Orders (STO) Pipeline Procurement Third-Party Processing Return Deliveries.

Module 8: Release Procedures & Workflow PR and PO Release Strategies Classification and Characteristics Release Codes and Indicators Workflow Basics Optional advanced.

Module 9: Reporting & Analytics Standard SAP MM Reports (ME2N, MB52, MB5T, etc.) Use of ALV Grid Custom Report Creation (Basics) Material Document List, Vendor Evaluation Reports.

Module 10: Integration with Other SAP Modules Integration with SAP FI (Invoice Verification, Account Postings) Integration with SAP SD (Stock Availability) Integration with SAP PP (Material Requirement Planning – MRP) Integration with SAP WM/EWM (Warehouse Management.

title: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD)
subtitle: SAP SD
description:
SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) is a comprehensive SAP ERP module designed to manage and optimize an organization’s complete order-to-cash (O2C) process, from customer inquiry and sales order creation to delivery, billing, and payment processing. This course provides practical knowledge of sales processes, pricing, availability checks, delivery management, billing, shipping, customer master data, and integration with other SAP modules. Learners will gain hands-on experience with real-time business scenarios and SAP S/4HANA SD processes, preparing them for roles such as SAP SD Consultant, SAP SD Functional Consultant, Sales Process Analyst, and SAP Support Consultant

This certification course provides comprehensive knowledge of SAP TM functionalities, integration with SAP ERP/S/4HANA, and real-time transportation planning and execution.

The course covers key concepts such as transportation network design, master data configuration, freight unit building, freight order management, carrier selection, route optimization, and freight settlement. Learners will gain hands-on understanding of both manual and automated transportation planning using SAP TM tools such as the Transportation Cockpit and optimizer.

description:
1. Course Description:  

SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) is an integrated cloud platform that helps 
organizations integrate, extend, automate, and develop business applications while managing 
data and analytics. SAP BTP combines capabilities such as database and data management, 
analytics, application development, integration, artificial intelligence, and automation. It 
enables businesses to connect SAP and non-SAP systems, build customized applications, 
modernize existing processes, and make data-driven decisions. Learning SAP BTP provides 
practical knowledge of Cloud Foundry, SAP Integration Suite, SAP HANA Cloud, SAP 
Analytics Cloud, SAP Build, APIs, and application development, making it valuable for 
modern SAP and cloud technology careers. 

2. Skills You Will Gain: 

 SAP BTP Architecture & Cloud Fundamentals  
 SAP HANA Cloud & Database Management  
 SAP Integration Suite & API Management  
 SAP Fiori & Application Development  
 SAP Build Apps & Process Automation 

3.The Course Content Enables Students To: 

  Develop and extend SAP cloud applications using SAP BTP.  
  Integrate SAP and non-SAP systems using APIs and Integration Suite.  
  Build custom applications, workflows, and business processes.  
  Manage data using SAP HANA Cloud and data services.  
  Implement security, authentication, and user access controls..

 Hands-on Project 
 End Assessment 
 Earn Credit Based Certificat

title: SAP Master Data Governance(MDG)
subtitle: SAP MDG
description:
SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) is a specialized training designed to teach you how to govern, manage, and maintain master data across an organization’s SAP landscape. MDG ensures high-quality, consistent, and governed data (like customer, vendor, material, and financial master data) by providing centralized processes, rules, and workflows to create, change, validate, and replicate master data across systems.

This course equips you with practical and theoretical knowledge about SAP’s MDG solution — particularly on SAP S/4HANA, which is widely used in global enterprises — enabling you to implement and manage MDG processes in real business environments

Manage enterprise-wide master data quality, governance, and compliance.

Combine MDG with core SAP modules to manage end-to-end master data processes.

Master Data Governance Expertise
Ability to configure, maintain, and manage enterprise master data governance processes across domains like Material, Vendor, Customer, and Finance.
Data Modeling & Configuration

Strong hands-on knowledge of setting up MDG change request workflows, approval processes, and BRF+ business rules.

Expertise in applying validation rules, derivation logic, duplicate checks, and cleansing mechanisms to maintain data accuracy.

title: SAP Vendor Invoice Management (VIM)
subtitle: SAP VIM
description:
SAP Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) by OpenText is an advanced solution designed to streamline, automate, and optimize the entire vendor invoice processing cycle within an organization. It integrates seamlessly with SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA, providing an end-to-end framework for invoice capture, validation, approval, exception handling, and posting.

VIM helps organizations reduce manual effort, eliminate invoice backlogs, improve compliance, and accelerate the procure-to-pay (P2P) cycle. It is widely used in large enterprises to improve operational efficiency, financial accuracy, and vendor satisfaction

Key Features of SAP VIM:
1. Automated Invoice Capture
Scans and imports invoices from email, PDF, scanner, or portals.
Uses OCR and intelligent document recognition (IDR) to extract invoice data automatically.
2. Workflow & Approval Automation
Routes invoices to the right approvers based on rules (amount, department, cost center, etc.)
Supports multi-level approvals and reminders.
3. Exception & Discrepancy Handling
Automatically detects mismatches (price, quantity, PO info).
Provides dashboards to resolve exceptions quickly.
4. Centralized Invoice Dashboard
Real-time visibility into invoice status, pending approvals, backlogs, and payment status.

Career Opportunities After SAP VIM:
1. SAP VIM Consultant (Functional)
Works on configuration, workflow design, and business process mapping.
Supports AP automation, PO/Non-PO invoice cycles, and exception handling.
2. SAP VIM Technical Consultant
Specializes in ABAP enhancements, OCR/IDR integration, and workflow development.
Works closely with functional consultants to deploy custom solutions.
3. SAP Accounts Payable (AP) Specialist / Process Expert
Manages invoice processing, posting, GR/IR matching, and vendor payments.
Ideal for candidates with finance background + VIM skills.
4. SAP P2P (Procure-to-Pay) Specialist
Work across procurement, purchase orders, vendor management, and invoice automation.
VIM knowledge adds strong value in P2P automation projects.

Essential Skills You Will Develop After Learning SAP VIM:
1. SAP Accounts Payable (AP) Process Knowledge
You gain a strong understanding of:
Invoice lifecycle (PO / Non-PO)
GR/IR matching
Payment cycles
Vendor management
AP compliance and audit processes

Introduction to C Programming History and Importance  Structure of a C Program Compilation and Execution Process Keywords, Identifiers, Constants, Variables Basic Input and Output (I/O).

Arithmetic, Relational, Logical, and Bitwise Operators Operator Precedence and Associativity Type Conversion Formatted.

Control Flow Conditional Statements: if, if-else, nested if Looping Constructs: for, while, do-while break, continue, and go to switch-case Statement.

Functions Function Definition and Declaration Call by Value and Call by Reference Recursion Storage Classes: auto, static, extern, register.

Arrays and Strings 1D and 2D Arrays String Handling and Manipulation

Pointers Pointer Basics and Arithmetic Pointers and Arrays
Pointers to Functions Dynamic Memory Allocation (malloc, free).

Module 7:
Structures and Unions Defining Structures Nested Structures and Arrays of Structures Pointers to Structures Unions and their Use Cases Enumerated Data Types.

Module 8:
File Handling File Operations: Reading, Writing File Pointers (open, close, read, write, print, scan) Random Access to Files Command Line Arguments.

Module 9:
Preprocessor and Macros define, #include, #ifdef, #ifndef Macros and Macro Functions Header Files Conditional Compilation.

Advanced Concepts and Project Introduction to C Libraries and Modular Programming Linked Lists (Basics) Mini Projects: Menu-driven Programs, Calculator, File-based Record Systems Assessment and Certification Test.

description:
The Autodesk Moldflow Analysis Training Certified Course is a comprehensive, industry-oriented program designed to equip learners with the knowledge and practical skills required to analyze, optimize, and validate plastic injection molding processes using Autodesk Moldflow. This course covers the complete workflow, from CAD model preparation and mesh generation to fill, pack, cool, warp, and defect analysis. Participants will learn how to predict manufacturing issues such as weld lines, air traps, sink marks, shrinkage, and warpage before production, helping reduce tooling costs, material waste, and product development time. Through hands-on projects, real-world case studies, and expert guidance, learners gain practical experience in mold design validation, process optimization, cooling system analysis, and material selection. Upon successful completion, participants receive a Course Completion Certificate, preparing them for careers in CAE Analysis, Plastic Product Design, Mold Design, Manufacturing Engineering, Automotive, Aerospace, Consumer Products, Medical Devices, and Industrial Plastic Manufacturing. This certification is ideal for Mechanical, Production, Polymer, Plastic, and Manufacturing Engineering students and professionals seeking industry-ready Autodesk Moldflow analysis skills.

The SAFE (Slab Analysis by Finite Element) Certified Course is a comprehensive, industry-oriented training program designed to equip civil and structural engineers with the skills required to analyze and design reinforced concrete floor systems, flat slabs, raft foundations, mat foundations, post-tensioned slabs, and transfer slabs using CSI SAFE. The course covers structural modeling, load definition, finite element analysis, slab design, punching shear checks, foundation design, reinforcement detailing, and result interpretation in accordance with international design codes. Participants will gain hands-on experience through real-world structural engineering projects, learning how to optimize slab and foundation designs for safety, serviceability, and cost-effectiveness. By the end of the program, learners will be proficient in using SAFE to perform accurate structural analysis, generate reinforcement details, validate design results, and deliver practical engineering solutions for residential, commercial, industrial, and infrastructure projects. Participants gain hands-on experience in 2D, 3D, and multi-axis machining, tool selection, workpiece setup, verification, and post-processing using Mastercam. Through practical projects and real-world manufacturing scenarios, learners develop the expertise needed to improve machining efficiency, reduce production time, and produce high-quality components for industries such as automotive, aerospace, precision engineering, mold & die, and industrial manufacturing. PSS®E (Power System Simulator for Engineering) Certified Course is a comprehensive industry-oriented training program designed to equip learners with the knowledge and practical skills required for power system analysis, planning, and operation. PSS®E, developed by Siemens, is one of the world's leading software solutions used by power utilities, transmission companies, renewable energy organizations, and consulting firms for electrical grid simulation and analysis. This course covers power flow analysis, short-circuit studies, contingency analysis, dynamic stability, fault analysis, renewable energy integration, and network modeling through hands-on practical sessions and real-time industry projects. Participants will also learn to automate simulations using Python scripting and apply industry best practices to solve real-world power system challenges. Upon successful completion, learners will be well-prepared for careers in power generation, transmission, distribution, renewable energy, electrical utilities, and power system consulting.

title: Penetration Testing Certified Course
subtitle: Penetration Testing
description:
The Penetration Testing Certified Course is a comprehensive cybersecurity training program designed to equip learners with the practical skills required to identify, assess, and exploit security vulnerabilities in computer systems, networks, web applications, and cloud environments—ethically and legally. This course combines foundational cybersecurity concepts with hands-on penetration testing techniques, enabling participants to simulate real-world cyberattacks and strengthen organizational security. Through industry-standard tools, live labs, and real-world projects, learners gain the expertise needed to perform vulnerability assessments, ethical hacking, security auditing, and reporting in compliance with cybersecurity best practices.

By the end of the course, participants will be able to plan and execute penetration tests, analyze security weaknesses, recommend effective remediation strategies, and prepare professional penetration testing reports. This program is ideal for aspiring ethical hackers, cybersecurity professionals, IT administrators, and anyone looking to build a successful career in offensive security

Key Features of Course Divine:
Collaboration with E‑Cell IIT Tirupati
1:1 Online Mentorship Platform
Credit-Based Certification
Live Classes Led by Industry Experts
Live, Real-World Projects
100% Placement Support
Potential Interview Training
Resume-Building Activities

Career Opportunities After Completing the Penetration Testing Certified Course:
Penetration Tester
Ethical Hacker
Cybersecurity Analyst
Information Security Analyst
Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) Engineer
Security Consultant
Red Team Specialist
Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst
Application Security Engineer
Network Security Engineer
Web Application Security Tester
Cloud Security Analyst

Essential Skills You Will Develop in the Penetration Testing Certified Course:
Understand cybersecurity fundamentals and ethical hacking methodologies.
Perform network reconnaissance and information gathering.
Conduct vulnerability assessment and security scanning.
Execute penetration testing on networks, web applications, and systems.
Identify, analyze, and exploit common security vulnerabilities ethically.
Perform web application security testing using industry-standard techniques.
Assess wireless network security and identify weaknesses.
Gain hands-on experience with Linux and Windows security environments.
Understand privilege escalation and post-exploitation techniques.
Test authentication, authorization, and access control mechanisms.
Perform password auditing and security assessment.

Tools Covered:
Kali Linux
Nmap
Metasploit Framework
Burp Suite
Wireshark
OWASP ZAP
Nessus
OpenVAS (Greenbone)
Nikto
SQLmap
Hydra
John the Ripper
Hashcat
Aircrack-ng

Syllabus:

Module 1: Introduction to Cybersecurity & Penetration Testing
Cybersecurity fundamentals and security principles
Ethical hacking methodologies and penetration testing lifecycle
Legal, ethical, and compliance considerations

Module 2: Networking Fundamentals
TCP/IP, OSI model, and network protocols
IP addressing, subnetting, and routing
Firewalls, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, and network services

Module 3: Linux & Windows Security
Linux command-line essentials
Windows administration and security basics
File permissions, users, groups, and system hardening

Module 4: Information Gathering & Reconnaissance
Passive and active reconnaissance
OSINT (Open Source Intelligence)
Domain, DNS, and network enumeration

Module 5: Vulnerability Assessment
Vulnerability scanning techniques
Identifying security weaknesses
Risk assessment and prioritization

Module 6: Network Penetration Testing
Port scanning and service enumeration
Exploitation techniques
Post-exploitation fundamentals

Module 7: Web Application Penetration Testing
OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities
SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, and authentication attacks
Web security testing methodologies

Module 8: Wireless Network Security
Wi-Fi security standards
Wireless attacks and defenses
Wireless penetration testing tools

Module 9: Password Attacks & Privilege Escalation
Password cracking techniques
Authentication security testing
Windows and Linux privilege escalation

Module 10: Reporting & Capstone Project
Professional penetration testing report writing
Remediation recommendations
End-to-end penetration testing project on a real-world lab environment

Industry Projects:
Enterprise Network Penetration Testing – Perform end-to-end security assessment of a corporate network to identify vulnerabilities and recommend remediation measures.
Web Application Security Assessment – Test a real-world web application for vulnerabilities such as SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), CSRF, and authentication flaws based on the OWASP Top 10.
Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) Project – Conduct comprehensive vulnerability scanning, exploitation, risk analysis, and prepare a professional VAPT report.
Wireless Network Security Audit – Assess Wi-Fi security by identifying weak configurations, testing encryption protocols, and recommending security improvements.
Cloud Infrastructure Security Assessment – Perform security testing on cloud-based environments to identify misconfigurations, exposed services, and access control issues.
Active Directory Penetration Testing – Enumerate Active Directory environments, identify privilege escalation paths, and demonstrate lateral movement techniques in a controlled lab.
Password Security & Authentication Audit – Evaluate password policies, perform password auditing, and assess authentication mechanisms for security weaknesses.
Capture the Flag (CTF) Challenge – Solve real-world cybersecurity scenarios involving reconnaissance, exploitation, privilege escalation, and flag capture.
Incident Response & Security Analysis Project – Investigate simulated cyberattacks, analyze security logs, identify attack vectors, and recommend mitigation strategies.

Who is this program for?
Students aspiring to build a career in cybersecurity and ethical hacking.
IT professionals looking to transition into penetration testing and offensive security.
Network Administrators and System Administrators seeking advanced security skills.
Cybersecurity Analysts who want hands-on penetration testing expertise.
Software Developers interested in secure coding and application security testing.
Security Engineers aiming to strengthen vulnerability assessment and exploitation skills.
Cloud Engineers and DevOps professionals focused on cloud security.
SOC (Security Operations Center) Analysts looking to expand into offensive security.
Security Auditors and Compliance Professionals responsible for security assessments.

description:
The Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)® Certified Course is a comprehensive training program designed for students, fresh graduates, and aspiring project management professionals who want to build a strong foundation in project management principles and practices. Based on globally recognized standards from the Project Management Institute, this course covers the complete project lifecycle, including project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling, and closing.

Participants will gain practical knowledge of project management methodologies, project scheduling, budgeting, risk management, quality management, stakeholder communication, and team collaboration. The program also provides focused preparation for the CAPM certification exam through practice tests, real-world case studies, and hands-on project exercises. By completing this course, learners will be equipped with the essential skills required to contribute effectively to project teams and pursue rewarding careers across industries such as IT, construction, manufacturing, healthcare, finance, and engineering.

description:
The Basic Life Support (BLS) Training Certified Course is a professional medical emergency response program designed to equip individuals with essential lifesaving skills. This course focuses on recognizing cardiac arrest, respiratory failure, and other life-threatening emergencies, and provides hands-on training in performing high-quality CPR (Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation), using an Automated External Defibrillator (AED), and providing effective rescue breathing.

Participants will learn how to respond quickly and confidently in emergency situations, both in clinical and non-clinical environments. The training follows internationally recognized guidelines and is suitable for healthcare professionals, students, first responders, and anyone interested in emergency care skills.

First Responder in Emergency Medical Services

High-quality CPR (Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation) for adults, children, and infants

title: Quantum computing foundation Certified Course
subtitle: Quantum computing foundation
description:
Quantum Computing Foundations is an introductory program that explores the principles of computation based on the laws of Quantum Mechanics. Unlike classical computing, which uses bits (0s and 1s), quantum computing leverages qubits that can exist in multiple states simultaneously through Superposition and interact via Quantum Entanglement.

This course builds a strong conceptual and practical understanding of how quantum systems process information. Learners will explore quantum gates, circuits, and algorithms, along with real-world applications such as cryptography, optimization, drug discovery, and artificial intelligence.

You will also gain hands-on exposure to industry-relevant tools like IBM Quantum Experience and programming frameworks such as Qiskit, enabling you to design and simulate quantum circuits.

By the end of this program, participants will understand the fundamentals of quantum computation, its advantages over classical systems, and its potential impact across industries, preparing them for advanced learning and emerging career opportunities in quantum technologies.

overview:
Quantum Computing Foundations is an introductory program that explores the principles of computation based on the laws of Quantum Mechanics. Unlike classical computing, which uses bits (0s and 1s), quantum computing leverages qubits that can exist in multiple states simultaneously through Superposition and interact via Quantum Entanglement.

This course builds a strong conceptual and practical understanding of how quantum systems process information. Learners will explore quantum gates, circuits, and algorithms, along with real-world applications such as cryptography, optimization, drug discovery, and artificial intelligence.

You will also gain hands-on exposure to industry-relevant tools like IBM Quantum Experience and programming frameworks such as Qiskit, enabling you to design and simulate quantum circuits.

By the end of this program, participants will understand the fundamentals of quantum computation, its advantages over classical systems, and its potential impact across industries, preparing them for advanced learning and emerging career opportunities in quantum technologies.

title: SAP UI5 Certified Course

description:
SAP UI5 is a front‑end development framework based on HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, and follows the MVC (Model‑View‑Controller) architecture. The certification course equips you to design, build, and deploy modern UI5/Fiori apps for SAP environments such as S/4HANA using tools like SAP Web IDE or Business Application Studio.

Key Features of Course Divine:
Collaboration with E‑Cell IIT Tirupati
1:1 Online Mentorship Platform
Credit-Based Certification
Live Classes Led by Industry Experts
Live, Real-World Projects
100% Placement Support
Potential Interview Training
Resume-Building Activities

Career Opportunities After SAP UI5 Certification:
SAP UI5/Fiori Developer – Build and customize enterprise SAP Fiori applications.
SAP Front-End Developer – Develop responsive web-based SAP interfaces using HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript.
SAP Fiori Consultant – Implement and optimize Fiori apps according to business requirements.
SAP UI5 Technical Consultant – Integrate UI5 apps with backend systems and optimize performance.
SAP Application Developer – Work on full-cycle SAP app development with OData services.
SAP Front-End Architect – Lead UI/UX design strategies for SAP Fiori applications.
SAP S/4HANA Developer – Develop UI5 apps integrated with SAP S/4HANA modules.
UI/UX Designer for SAP Applications – Focus on improving user experience and interface design following Fiori UX principles.

Essential Skills you Will Develop In a SAP UI5 Certified Course:
SAP UI5 Development – Build responsive, enterprise-ready web applications using the SAP UI5 framework.
MVC Architecture Understanding – Implement applications using Model-View-Controller (MVC) design principles.
HTML5, CSS3 & JavaScript Proficiency – Master front-end web technologies essential for SAP UI5 development.
UI5 Controls & Layouts – Use built-in UI5 components to design user-friendly interfaces.
Data Binding & Models – Work with JSON, OData, and XML models for dynamic data handling.
Routing & Navigation – Manage application navigation between views/screens efficiently.
SAP Fiori UX Principles – Apply Fiori design guidelines to enhance user experience.
Backend Integration – Connect UI5 apps with SAP systems via OData services.

Tools Covered:
SAP Web IDE – Cloud-based development environment for SAP UI5 and Fiori apps.
SAP Business Application Studio – Advanced IDE for building and testing UI5 applications.
SAP Fiori Launchpad – Platform to deploy and launch SAP Fiori/UI5 apps.
OData Services – Connect and integrate UI5 applications with backend SAP systems.
XML & HTML Editors – For designing UI5 views and layouts.
JavaScript Debugging Tools – Console and debugger tools for troubleshooting UI5 apps.
Git & Version Control – Source code management and collaboration for development projects.
SAP Fiori Elements – Predefined templates to accelerate Fiori app development.

Syllabus:

Module 1: Introduction to SAP UI5
Overview of SAP UI5 and Fiori
SAP UI5 architecture & MVC concept
UI5 vs traditional SAP GUI
Setting up development environment (Web IDE / Business Application Studio)

Module 2: HTML5, CSS3 & JavaScript Basics
Basics of HTML5 for UI5 development
Styling with CSS3
JavaScript fundamentals for SAP UI5
DOM manipulation & event handling

Module 3: Views and Controllers
XML, HTML, and JS views
Creating and linking controllers
Event handling in UI5 applications
Lifecycle of UI5 applications

Module 4: UI5 Controls and Layouts
Common UI5 controls (Buttons, Tables, Lists, Forms, Dialogs)
Layout controls (VBox, HBox, Grid, FlexBox)
Responsive UI design principles

Module 5: Models and Data Binding
JSON, XML, and OData models
Two-way data binding
Aggregation and property binding
Working with real-time data

Module 6: Routing and Navigation
Routing concepts in SAP UI5
Navigating between views
Passing parameters between views
Master-Detail application setup

Module 7: SAP Fiori Design Guidelines
Fiori UX principles
Using Fiori elements and templates
Smart controls and annotations
Customizing Fiori UI

Module 8: Backend Integration
Consuming OData services
Connecting UI5 apps with SAP S/4HANA
CRUD operations on backend data
Error handling and validations

Module 9: Debugging and Testing
UI5 debugging tools (UI5 Inspector, Chrome DevTools)
Unit testing for UI5 applications
Performance optimization
Best practices for code quality

Module 10: Application Deployment
Deploying UI5 apps to Fiori Launchpad
Version control and Git integration
Packaging and transport management
Maintaining and updating deployed applications

Industry Projects:
Employee Leave Management System – Build a Fiori app for leave requests and approvals.
Sales Order Tracking Dashboard – Monitor and visualize sales orders with dynamic data.
Inventory Management Application – Track stock levels and movements with CRUD operations.
Purchase Requisition Approval App – Manage approval workflows in a UI5 application.
Customer Feedback Portal – Collect and display feedback using forms, tables, and charts.
Employee Onboarding Application – Manage onboarding tasks and documentation digitally.
Expense Management App – Submit and approve employee expenses integrated with backend.

title: SAP Business Objects Data Services (BODS)
subtitle: SAP BODS
description:
SAP BusinessObjects Data Services (BODS) is an enterprise‑grade ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) and data integration tool used to extract data from multiple sources, transform and cleanse it, and load it into target systems like data warehouses, analytical platforms, or operational systems. It’s a key part of the SAP BusinessObjects suite used for reliable data integration, data quality, and data management within large businesses.

Key Features of Course Divine:
Collaboration with E‑Cell IIT Tirupati
1:1 Online Mentorship Platform
Credit-Based Certification
Live Classes Led by Industry Experts
Live, Real-World Projects
100% Placement Support
Potential Interview Training
Resume-Building Activities

Career Opportunities After Completing SAP BusinessObjects Data Services (BODS) certification:
ETL Developer – Design, develop, and maintain ETL workflows to move and transform data between systems.
Data Integration Specialist – Handle complex data integration projects using SAP BODS across multiple databases and platforms.
SAP BODS Consultant – Work with organizations to implement SAP BODS solutions for data migration, cleansing, and warehousing.
Business Intelligence (BI) Developer – Support BI initiatives by ensuring accurate, clean, and structured data flows into analytics platforms.
Data Quality Analyst – Focus on data cleansing, profiling, and validation using SAP BODS data quality tools.
Data Migration Specialist – Assist in SAP ECC to S/4HANA or other ERP migration projects using SAP BODS for seamless data transfer.
Data Warehouse Developer – Design and maintain enterprise data warehouses with proper ETL processes.
SAP BODS Administrator – Manage repository, jobs, servers, and user access in SAP BODS environments.
BI/Data Analyst – Leverage data prepared via BODS to generate reports, dashboards, and insights for decision-making.
SAP Project Manager (Data Focus) – Lead SAP data integration and ETL projects with end-to-end implementation experience.

Essential Skills You Will Develop SAP BusinessObjects Data Services (BODS) Certified Course:
ETL Development Skills – Ability to design, build, and optimize ETL workflows and data pipelines for large-scale data processing.
Data Extraction & Integration – Extract data from multiple sources (databases, SAP ECC/S4HANA, flat files) and integrate it into target systems.
Data Transformation & Cleansing – Use mappings, transforms, and data quality functions to clean, standardize, and enrich data.
Data Quality Management – Perform profiling, validation, and error handling to ensure accurate and reliable data.
Repository & Job Management – Manage BODS repositories, versions, jobs, and workflows efficiently.
Debugging & Troubleshooting – Detect, debug, and resolve errors in ETL jobs and data flows.
Performance Tuning – Optimize ETL processes for high-volume, real-time, or batch data processing.
SAP BODS Administration – Understand server configuration, scheduling, and monitoring of ETL jobs.
Reporting & Analytics Support – Prepare data for BI reporting, dashboards, and analytics.
Problem-Solving & Logical Thinking – Apply analytical and logical thinking to solve complex data integration challenges.

Tools Covered:
SAP BusinessObjects Data Services Designer – Core development environment for creating ETL jobs, mappings, and workflows.
SAP BusinessObjects Data Services Job Server – For executing, scheduling, and monitoring ETL jobs.
SAP Data Services Management Console (DSMC) – Web-based tool for administration, job monitoring, and repository management.
SAP Data Services Repository – Central storage for all objects, mappings, jobs, and version control.
SAP Data Services Designer Transform Functions – Built-in functions for data transformation, cleansing, validation, and enrichment.
SAP Information Platform Services (IPS) – Supports metadata management and connectivity with SAP BI tools.
Database Connectivity Tools – Connectors for Oracle, SQL Server, SAP HANA, MySQL, and other data sources.
Data Profiling Tools – For analyzing, profiling, and ensuring data quality before integration.
SAP BusinessObjects BI Integration – Tools to integrate cleansed data into SAP BI dashboards, reports, and analytics.
Scheduling & Automation Tools – Utilities to automate job execution, error handling, and reporting.

Syllabus:

Module 1: Introduction to SAP BODS
Overview of SAP BusinessObjects Data Services
ETL concepts and data warehousing fundamentals
SAP BODS architecture and components

Module 2: Data Services Designer
Navigating the BODS Designer interface
Creating projects, jobs, and workflows
Understanding mappings, transforms, and data flows

Module 3: Data Extraction Techniques
Connecting to different data sources (SAP, databases, files)
Extracting structured and unstructured data
Incremental vs. full data extraction

Module 4: Data Transformation & Cleansing
Using built-in transforms (join, merge, pivot)
Data cleansing and standardization techniques
Error handling and data validation

Module 5: Data Loading & Integration
Loading data into target systems (data warehouse, BI systems)
Real-time vs. batch data loading
Best practices for data integration

Module 6: Data Quality Management
Data profiling, auditing, and validation
Data standardization and enrichment
Monitoring and reporting data quality issues

Module 7: Repository & Version Management
Understanding local and central repositories
Version control and object management
Importing/exporting objects across environments

Module 8: Job Scheduling & Administration
Job scheduling and automation
Monitoring job execution and performance
Configuring job servers and servers management

Module 9: Advanced Features & Real-Time Jobs
Real-time data integration scenarios
Parameterization, reusable transforms, and templates
Performance optimization techniques

Module 10: SAP BODS Project & Certification Prep
End-to-end project development
Hands-on exercises and real-world case studies
Exam preparation for SAP BODS certification

Industry Projects:
Data Migration from legacy systems to SAP HANA/SAP BW
End-to-end ETL Workflow Development
Data Quality and Cleansing Projects
Real-Time Data Integration Workflows
BI Reporting & Dashboard Data Preparation
Customer 360 Data Integration
Finance & Accounting Data ETL Projects
Healthcare Data Integration
E-Commerce Sales Data Pipeline
Data Warehouse Optimization and Performance Tuning

Who is this program for?
ETL Developers – Professionals looking to build and optimize ETL workflows.
Data Integration Specialists – Those handling data migration, consolidation, and integration projects.
SAP Consultants – SAP professionals working on ECC, S/4HANA, or BI projects requiring data integration skills.
Business Intelligence (BI) Professionals – Analysts and developers preparing data for reporting and analytics.
Database & Data Warehouse Professionals – Individuals managing large-scale data warehouses and pipelines.
Data Analysts & Data Quality Experts – People interested in cleansing, profiling, and validating enterprise data.
Fresh Graduates & IT Professionals – Anyone aiming for a career in SAP data services, ETL, or data warehousing.

title: SAP Application Link Enabling (ALE)
subtitle: SAP ALE
description:
The SAP ALE (Application Link Enabling) Certified Course is a specialized training program designed to provide in-depth knowledge of SAP’s integration technology used for connecting multiple SAP and non-SAP systems. This course focuses on enabling seamless data exchange and distributed business processes across different enterprise systems.

SAP ALE is a middleware technology that ensures controlled and consistent data communication between distributed applications without relying on a central database. It uses messaging architecture (primarily IDocs) to transfer data efficiently between systems.

Key Features of Course Divine:
Collaboration with E‑Cell IIT Tirupati
1:1 Online Mentorship Platform
Credit-Based Certification
Live Classes Led by Industry Experts
Live, Real-World Projects
100% Placement Support
Potential Interview Training
Resume-Building Activities

Career Opportunities After SAP ALE (Application Link Enabling) Course:
SAP ALE Consultant
Design, configure, and manage ALE-based integrations between SAP systems.
SAP Integration Consultant
Work on connecting SAP with external systems using IDocs, APIs, and middleware tools.
SAP Technical Consultant (ABAP + ALE)
Develop and customize IDocs, enhance data exchange processes, and support integration requirements.
Middleware / Interface Specialist
Handle system communication, monitor interfaces, and ensure smooth data flow across platforms.
SAP EDI Consultant
Manage Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) processes integrated with ALE for business transactions

Essential Skills You Will Develop SAP ALE (Application Link Enabling):
Application Link Enabling (ALE) Configuration Skills
Learn to configure ALE settings for seamless communication between SAP systems.
Intermediate Document (IDoc) Management Skills
Gain expertise in creating, processing, and monitoring IDocs for data exchange.
Remote Function Call (RFC) Integration Skills
Understand how to set up and manage RFC connections between systems.
SAP System Integration Skills
Develop the ability to integrate SAP with other SAP and non-SAP applications.
Distribution Model Configuration Skills
Learn to design and manage distribution models for efficient data flow.
Partner Profile Configuration Skills
Gain hands-on experience in setting up inbound and outbound partner profiles.
Inbound and Outbound Processing Skills
Master the handling of data transmission in both directions within ALE.
Error Handling and Troubleshooting Skills
Identify, analyze, and resolve IDoc and integration errors effectively.
Data Mapping and Transformation Skills
Learn how to map and transform data between different systems.
SAP NetWeaver Application Server (AS ABAP) Skills
Understand the technical foundation supporting ALE processes.
Change Pointer and Data Distribution Skills
Learn techniques for tracking and distributing data changes across systems.
Monitoring and Performance Optimization Skills
Ensure smooth system performance through effective monitoring tools.

Tools Covered:
SAP Intermediate Document (IDoc) Interface
Used for structured data exchange between SAP and external systems.
Remote Function Call (RFC)
Enables communication and function execution between different SAP systems.
SAP NetWeaver Application Server (AS ABAP)
Core platform that supports ALE configuration and execution.
SAP ALE Configuration Transactions (SALE)
Central tool for configuring ALE settings and distribution models.
IDoc Monitoring Tools (WE02 / WE05)
Used to track, analyze, and troubleshoot IDocs.
Partner Profile Management (WE20)
Configure inbound and outbound communication parameters.

Define technical communication ports for IDoc processing.
Distribution Model (BD64)
Tool to define and manage data distribution across systems.
Message Type Management (WE81 / WE82)
Configure and link message types with IDoc types.
Change Pointer Activation (BD50 / BD52)
Track changes in master data for automatic distribution.
Function Builder (SE37)
Create and test RFC-enabled function modules.
Data Dictionary (SE11)
Manage database tables and structures related to IDocs.

description:
Power Electronics Design – Certified Course Description

The Power Electronics Design Certified Course is a comprehensive program designed to equip learners with in-depth knowledge of designing, analyzing, and implementing modern power electronic systems. This course covers fundamental concepts such as power semiconductor devices, switching techniques, and converter topologies, along with advanced topics like control strategies, thermal management, and high-frequency design.

Learners will gain hands-on experience in designing DC-DC converters, inverters, and rectifiers, along with simulation and real-time testing of power circuits. The course emphasizes practical applications, enabling students to develop efficient and reliable power systems used in industries such as renewable energy, electric vehicles, automation, and consumer electronics.

By the end of the program, participants will be able to design complete power electronic circuits, select appropriate components, optimize performance, and solve real-world engineering challenges using industry-standard tools and methodologies.

description:
The Certificate in Animal Husbandry is a comprehensive program designed to provide foundational knowledge and practical skills in the care, management, and breeding of livestock. This course focuses on essential aspects such as animal nutrition, health care, disease prevention, and farm management, enabling students to effectively handle domestic animals and improve productivity in the livestock sector.

Students will gain an understanding of animal anatomy, physiology, feeding techniques, and modern farming practices. The program also emphasizes hands-on training, allowing learners to develop real-world skills in dairy farming, poultry management, and livestock production.

This course is ideal for individuals interested in agriculture, veterinary support roles, dairy farming, and entrepreneurship in animal-based industries. Upon completion, candidates can explore opportunities in farms, dairy units, poultry industries, animal care centers, or start their own livestock business.

title: SAP Identity and Access Management (IAM) Certified Course
subtitle: SAP IAM
description:
The SAP Identity and Access Management (IAM) Certified Course is designed to provide comprehensive knowledge of managing user identities, roles, and access controls within SAP environments. This course focuses on the key concepts of identity governance, authentication, authorization, and access management, ensuring secure and compliant access to business-critical SAP systems.

Participants will learn how to create and manage SAP users, configure role-based access control (RBAC), implement secure authentication mechanisms, and monitor user activities for compliance and security purposes. The course also covers SAP security policies, segregation of duties (SoD), risk management, and governance practices that help organizations maintain strong access control and data protection.

Through hands-on training, practical exercises, and real-time project scenarios, learners will gain the skills required to manage identity provisioning, perform security audits, and implement best practices for SAP IAM systems. This course prepares professionals to support organizations in maintaining secure, efficient, and compliant SAP system operations.

title: DevOps Production Support Engineer Certification Course
subtitle: DevOps Production Support Engineer
description:
The DevOps Production Support Engineer Certification Course is designed to equip learners with the practical skills required to manage, monitor, and maintain large-scale production environments. This program focuses on real-time troubleshooting, infrastructure monitoring, log analysis, automation, and CI/CD pipeline support. Students will gain deep expertise in Linux administration, cloud platforms, container orchestration, configuration management, and incident management workflows used in modern DevOps teams. Through hands-on labs, real-world simulations, and industry use cases, learners will master root-cause analysis, performance tuning, system reliability, and on-call support practices. This course prepares professionals to ensure seamless application availability, reduce downtime, enhance operational efficiency, and support mission-critical deployments across enterprise DevOps environments.

Skills You Will Gain:
Strong proficiency in Linux/Unix administration, shell scripting, and system troubleshooting
Ability to monitor infrastructure using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Nagios, CloudWatch, etc.
Expertise in CI/CD pipeline support, including Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps
Skills in log analysis & monitoring using ELK/EFK stack, Splunk, and cloud-native tools
Understanding of incident management, on-call support processes, SLAs, and escalation workflows
Knowledge of containerization & orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) for production support
Ability to identify performance bottlenecks and perform root-cause analysis (RCA)
Hands-on skills in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) for environment management and troubleshooting

The Course Enables Students To:
Understand real-time production support workflows, ticketing systems, and on-call procedures
Monitor applications, servers, and cloud resources using industry-standard DevOps monitoring tools
Diagnose and resolve production incidents, outages, and performance issues
Perform root-cause analysis (RCA) and generate incident reports
Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines, ensuring smooth deployments and environment stability
Analyze application logs using ELK/Splunk and automate alerting and troubleshooting
Manage cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP) and apply best practices for reliability
troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters, Docker containers, and microservices-based architectures

SYLLABUS:

Module 1: Introduction to DevOps & Production Support
DevOps concepts, culture, and roles
Production vs non-production environments
Release cycles, SLAs, on-call duties
Incident, problem, and change management basics

Module 2: Linux/Unix Administration for Production Support
Linux commands & file system management
User & permission management
Processes, system services, system logs
Shell scripting for automation

Module 3: Networking Essentials
TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls
Debugging network issues (ping, traceroute, netstat)
Understanding ports, protocols, and connectivity troubleshooting

Module 4: Monitoring & Alerting
Monitoring fundamentals
Server, application & database monitoring
Setting alerts & thresholds
Hands-on with monitoring dashboards

Module 5: Log Management & Analysis
Log types & log rotation
Log collection and parsing
Error analysis & troubleshooting
Building dashboards & alert rules

Module 6: CI/CD Pipeline Support
Pipeline concepts and stages
Build, test, deploy automation
Troubleshooting failing builds & deployments
CI/CD best practices

Module 7: Cloud Operations & Troubleshooting
Cloud fundamentals (AWS/Azure/GCP)
Cloud monitoring & logs
VM, storage, network troubleshooting
IAM & access management basics

Module 8: Docker & Kubernetes for Production Support
Docker basics & container troubleshooting
Kubernetes components & architecture
Pod failures, node issues, service debugging
Logs, events, and resource usage analysis

Module 9: Configuration Management & Infrastructure Automation
Introduction to Ansible/Puppet/Chef
Automating server updates & configurations
Writing playbooks & configuration scripts
Version control with Git

Module 10: Incident, Problem & Change Management
Incident lifecycle & severity levels
Root-Cause Analysis (RCA)
Creating incident reports
Change requests, approvals & deployments

Skills You Will Develop:
Ability to manage and troubleshoot Linux/Unix systems in production environments
Strong skills in diagnosing application, server, and network issues
Expertise in monitoring systems using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Nagios, CloudWatch, etc.
Proficiency in analyzing logs using ELK/EFK, Splunk, and cloud-native log services
Capability to support, maintain, and fix CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps)
Hands-on experience with Docker containers and troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters
Skills in automating routine tasks using Shell scripting and Python

The course blends core infrastructure knowledge, cloud integrations, Linux administration, virtualization, networking, and data center automation to produce highly competent data center professionals.

This certification prepares participants to work with mission-critical data center systems, focusing on high availability, energy efficiency, monitoring, redundancy planning, and enterprise-level IT operations.

Strong understanding of data center architecture, components, and critical systems

KVM / Hyper-V – Hypervisors for enterprise environments
Networking Tools – Cisco Packet Tracer, Wireshark, Putty, SSH tools

Automation Tools – Ansible, Shell scripting, Cron jobs

Module 1: Data Center Fundamentals
Types of data centers
Core components & standards

Redundancy concepts (N, N+1, 2N)

Rack units, chassis, blades
CPU, memory, storage architecture
Power distribution, sensors
Hardware troubleshooting

User/permission management
Package management
System services, processes, logs

Shell scripting basics
Variables, loops, conditionals
Automating system tasks
Cron jobs & maintenance scripts

Module 5: OpenBMC & Remote Server Management
BMC architecture overview
IPMI/Redfish interfaces
Remote monitoring & provisioning
Firmware updates & health checks

Module 6: Data Center Networking
Networking fundamentals
VLANs, routing & switching
Load balancers, firewalls
Network troubleshooting tools

Module 7: Virtualization & Hypervisors
Virtualization concepts
VMware, KVM, Hyper-V overview
VM provisioning & resource allocation
Snapshot, cloning, templates

Module 8: Storage Systems & Backup
RAID levels & disk management
SAN, NAS, DAS architecture
iSCSI, Fiber Channel basics
Backup & recovery strategies

Module 9: Security, Monitoring & High Availability
Physical & network security
Access controls & audit trails
Monitoring tools (alerts, logs, dashboards)
Failover systems & clustering

Module 10: Disaster Recovery & Data Center Automation
DR planning & RTO/RPO concepts
Replication & failover methods
Automation tools for DC operations
Capstone real-time project

Design and deploy a full data center rack layout including servers, switches, PDUs, and cooling planning.

Install, configure, and automate routine tasks using Bash scripts (user creation, backups, monitoring).

Use BMC, IPMI/Redfish tools to perform remote power cycling, firmware updates, and health monitoring.

Set up hypervisors, create virtual machines, configure networks, and optimize resource allocation.

Configure firewalls, access control lists, and harden Linux servers for data center-level security.

SAP Data Migration & Data Quality courses teach you how to plan, execute, clean, validate, and migrate data between systems — especially into SAP environments like SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA. These are critical skills in implementation projects and digital transformations.
They cover topics like:

Migration lifecycle — planning, extraction, mapping, loading, and reconciliation.

Data quality management — cleansing, standardizing, deduplication, and validation.

Use of key SAP tools such as LSMW, Migration Cockpit, BODS (SAP Data Services), and S/4HANA specific utilities.
Completing these courses can prepare you for SAP consulting roles like Data Migration Consultant, Data Services Developer, Data Quality Analyst, or Master Data Governance Specialist.

Collaboration with E‑Cell IIT Tirupati

Live Classes Led by Industry Experts

Understanding complete data migration lifecycle

Post-migration reconciliation & error handling

Duplicate identification & removal

Ensuring data accuracy, completeness & consistency

SAP Migration Cockpit (LTMC / LTMOM)
SAP LSMW (Legacy System Migration Workbench)

LSMW (Legacy System Migration Workbench)

Overview of SAP ECC & S/4HANA data migration
Importance of data quality in migration projects

Understanding data quality dimensions (accuracy, completeness, consistency)

Hands-on migration of master and transactional data
Implementing data quality measures on real datasets
Post-migration validation, reporting, and best practices

title: Printed Circuit Board (PCB) design Certified Course
subtitle: Printed Circuit Board (PCB)
description:
The Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Design Certified Course is a comprehensive, industry-oriented program designed to equip learners with the skills required to design, analyze, and produce high-quality PCBs used across electronics, embedded systems, and IoT applications. This course blends theoretical knowledge with hands-on training using professional PCB design tools, ensuring participants gain job-ready expertise.

Key Features of Course Divine:
Collaboration with E‑Cell IIT Tirupati
1:1 Online Mentorship Platform
Credit-Based Certification
Live Classes Led by Industry Experts
Live, Real-World Projects
100% Placement Support
Potential Interview Training
Resume-Building Activities

Skills You Will Gain
Understanding PCB fundamentals & electronic components
Schematic design and circuit drafting
PCB layout design (1-layer, 2-layer & multi-layer boards)
Routing techniques: manual & auto-routing
High-speed design principles
Gerber generation & fabrication file preparation
Course Content Enables Students To:
Understand PCB manufacturing standards (IPC)
Create symbols, footprints, and component libraries
Prepare layer stack-ups and power/ground planes
Perform differential pair routing & impedance control
Apply thermal management and heat dissipation techniques
Simulate circuits and validate PCB performance

Essential Skills You Will Gain (PCB):
Electronic Component Understanding
Ability to identify, interpret, and select resistors, capacitors, ICs, connectors, and power components.
Schematic Design Expertise
Creating circuit schematics, understanding net connections, library creation, and reading datasheets.
PCB Layout Design
Board outline creation, component placement, multi-layer stack-up, footprint design, and design rule settings.
Routing & High-Speed Design
Manual and auto-routing, differential pair routing, impedance control, and signal integrity optimization.
Gerber & Fabrication File Preparation

Tools Covered
Altium Designer – Industry-standard tool for professional PCB design and multi-layer boards
KiCad – Open-source EDA suite for schematic capture and PCB layout
Autodesk Eagle – Popular for hobby, startup, and mid-level PCB design
OrCAD – Advanced tool for circuit design and simulation used in large-scale industries
Proteus – Circuit simulation and PCB design tool extensively used in embedded systems
EasyEDA – Cloud-based PCB design platform ideal for quick prototyping and hobby projects

Syllabus

Module 1: Introduction to PCB Design
What is PCB?
Types of PCBs (Single, Double, Multi-layer)
PCB materials & standards (IPC basics)
Electronic components & footprints
PCB applications in industry

Module 2: Electronic Circuit & Schematic Design
Circuit fundamentals
Schematic drafting
Net labels & connectivity
Library creation (symbols & footprints)
Reading datasheets

Module 3: PCB Layout Fundamentals
Board outline creation
Layer stack-up
Component placement guidelines
Vias, tracks, pads & clearances
Grounding and power distribution basics

Module 4: Routing Techniques
Manual & auto-routing
High-speed routing basics
Differential pair routing
Power routing & signal flow
Impedance control

Module 5: EMI/EMC & Signal Integrity
Noise reduction techniques
Ground planes & shielding
Crosstalk prevention
PCB design for stable signal performance

Module 6: Power & Thermal Management
Power electronics PCB design
Heat dissipation techniques
Thermal vias
Component derating & safety

Module 7: Preparing Manufacturing Files
Gerber file generation
BOM creation
Pick-and-place files
Fabrication drawing
Design rule check (DRC) & electrical rule check (ERC)

Module 8: DFM, DFA & DFT
Design for manufacturability
Design for assembly
Design for testing
Industry best practices

Module 9: Simulation & Validation
Circuit simulation basics
SPICE simulations
Signal integrity analysis
PCB verification & debugging

Module 10: Live Industry Project
End-to-end PCB design
Schematic to Gerber output
Review & corrections
Fabrication-ready submission

Industry Projects
1. Sensor-Based IoT PCB Design
Design a custom PCB using sensors (temperature, humidity, motion, etc.) integrated with microcontrollers like ESP32/STM32.
Key Skills: Schematic drafting, component placement, routing, IoT interface design.
2. Power Supply PCB (AC–DC / DC–DC Converter)
Develop a regulated power supply board with protection circuits.
Key Skills: Power electronics design, thermal management, EMI/EMC considerations.
3. Microcontroller Development Board
Create a custom development board similar to Arduino/ESP32 with USB interface, regulators, reset, and GPIO expansion.
Key Skills: Multi-layer PCB design, power routing, external interfaces.

Who Is This Program For?
Engineering Students (ECE, EEE, EIE, CSE, Mechanical with IoT interest)

Diploma & Polytechnic Students
Looking to enter electronics design and manufacturing industries.
Embedded Systems & IoT Enthusiasts

Seeking to upgrade from basic wiring to professional PCB layout design.
Beginner to Intermediate Learners in Electronics
Who want to understand circuit design, simulation, and fabrication.

title: Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP) Cesrtification Course
subtitle: Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP)
description:
Course Desription:

The Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP) course is a globally recognized certification designed to build strong expertise in data protection and privacy laws. It provides a comprehensive understanding of how personal data is collected, processed, stored, and protected across different regulatory frameworks such as GDPR and other regional privacy regulations. The course focuses on privacy governance, compliance requirements, data subject rights, cross-border data transfers, and organizational accountability. Ideal for legal, IT, compliance, risk, and security professionals, the CIPP certification equips learners with practical knowledge to design, implement, and manage privacy programs, ensuring organizations meet regulatory obligations while building trust and transparency in today’s data-driven environment.

Syllabus:

Module 1:
Introduction to Data Privacy & Information Protection Privacy fundamentals, personal data concepts, data lifecycle, importance of privacy in digital ecosystems, and global privacy trends.

Module 2:
Global Privacy Frameworks & Regulations Overview of major privacy laws such as GDPR, ePrivacy Directive, CCPA, and other international data protection regulations.

Module 3:
GDPR – Core Principles & Lawful Processing GDPR principles, lawful bases for processing, consent management, data minimization, and accountability.

Module 4:
Data Subject Rights & Organizational Obligations Right to access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection, restriction of processing, and handling data subject requests.

Module 5:
Privacy Governance & Compliance Programs Privacy governance structures, policies, procedures, roles and responsibilities, and compliance monitoring.

Module 6:
Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) Risk-based approach, DPIA methodology, identifying high-risk processing, and mitigation strategies.

Cross-Border Data Transfers & Third-Party Management International data transfers, SCCs, adequacy decisions, vendor risk management, and contracts.

description:
Course Description:

This course explores the security implications and risks introduced by quantum computing, with a strong focus on how quantum technologies impact today’s cryptographic systems. Learners will understand why widely used encryption methods such as RSA, ECC, and Diffie–Hellman are vulnerable to quantum attacks, and how organizations can prepare for a post-quantum world. The course covers quantum threat models, quantum-safe and post-quantum cryptography standards, risk assessment strategies, migration planning, and compliance considerations. Through real-world case studies and practical frameworks, participants gain the knowledge required to evaluate quantum risks, design resilient security architectures, and safeguard data against future quantum-enabled cyber threats.

title: Cloud Security Fundamentals Certified Course
subtitle: Cloud Security Fundamentals
description:
Course Description:

Cloud Security Fundamentals provides a strong foundation in protecting data, applications, and infrastructure across cloud platforms. This course covers core security principles, shared responsibility models, identity and access management, encryption, threat detection, and compliance frameworks. You will learn how to secure cloud environments on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud using industry-standard tools and best practices. By the end of the course, learners will be able to identify vulnerabilities, implement security controls, and build a resilient cloud security strategy suitable for modern enterprises.

Key Features of Course Divine:
Collaboration with E‑Cell IIT Tirupati
1:1 Online Mentorship Platform
Credit-Based Certification
Live Classes Led by Industry Experts
Live, Real-World Projects

Cloud Compliance Specialist
Cloud Risk & Governance Consultant
Cybersecurity Analyst (Cloud Focus)
Cloud Infrastructure Security Specialist
Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst

Essential Skills you will Develop Cloud Security Fundamentals Certified Course:
Understanding of cloud security principles and architecture
Ability to implement IAM and access control policies
Skills in data protection, encryption, and key management
Knowledge of cloud threat detection and incident response
Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, and GCP security tools
Ability to evaluate cloud risks and apply security best practices
Understanding of compliance, governance, and regulatory standards
Securing cloud networks, workloads, and applications
Implementing monitoring and logging for cloud environments
Building end-to-end cloud security strategies for organizations

Tools Covered:
AWS Security
Microsoft Azure Security Center
Google Cloud Security Command Center (SCC)
Cloud Access Security Brokers (CASB)
Identity & Access Management 
Cloud Monitoring 
Encryption & Key Management 
Network Security 

Compliance & Governance

Syllabus:

Module 1:
Introduction to Cloud Computing & Security Basics Cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) Cloud deployment models Shared Responsibility Model Core cloud security challenges.

Module 2:
Cloud Architecture & Security Principles Zero Trust security model Identity-based security Network segmentation Secure workload design.

Module 3:
Identity & Access Management (IAM) Authentication vs Authorization Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Privileged Access Management IAM best practices.

Module 4:
Cloud Network Security Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) Firewalls, Security Groups, NACLs VPNs & Direct Connect DDoS protection Secure network architecture patterns.

Module 5:
Data Security in the Cloud Data classification Encryption (at rest, in transit, in use) Key Management Service (KMS) Storage security Backup & disaster recovery planning.

Module 6:
Cloud Monitoring, Logging & Threat Detection SIEM & central logging Cloud-native monitoring tools Intrusion detection/prevention Endpoint security Real-time alerting & anomaly detection.

Module 7:
Application Security in Cloud Secure coding principles API security DevSecOps fundamentals Container & Kubernetes security Vulnerability scanning.

Module 8:
Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Cloud security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001) Policy management Risk assessment Compliance requirements (GDPR, PCI-DSS, HIPAA).

Module 9:
Security Automation & Incident Response Automated remediation Security orchestration Cloud incident response lifecycle Forensics in cloud environments Playbooks & response.

Module 10:
Cloud Provider Security Tools AWS: IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, WAF, Inspector Azure: Azure AD, Defender, Sentinel, Key Vault GCP: IAM, Cloud Armor, Chronicle, Security Command Center Hands-on security labs.

Industry Projects:

title: Security Testing with Burp Suite Certified Course
subtitle: Security Testing with Burp Suite
description:
Course Description:

This course provides a comprehensive introduction to web application security testing using the industry-standard tool Burp Suite. You will learn how to identify, analyze, and exploit vulnerabilities such as SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, authentication flaws, and insecure configurations through hands-on practice. The program covers essential modules including proxy setup, spidering, scanning, repeater, intruder, decoder, and advanced exploitation workflows. By the end of the course, you will be able to perform real-world penetration tests, generate security reports, and strengthen application security using Burp Suite’s powerful toolkit.

subtitle: SAP LSMW
description:
Course Description:

The SAP LSMW (Legacy System Migration Workbench) course is designed to equip learners with the skills required to efficiently migrate data from legacy systems into SAP systems. This tool is essential for organizations transitioning to SAP, allowing users to automate, map, and transfer large volumes of data accurately. Through hands-on exercises and real-time projects, learners will gain in-depth knowledge of data extraction, field mapping, transformation rules, and import methods. The course covers various data migration techniques, batch input recording, and direct input methods, ensuring a strong foundation in managing end-to-end data migration processes. By the end of the program, participants will be able to execute and validate complex data transfers seamlessly in SAP environments.

The Computer Numerical Control (CNC) Programming Course is designed to provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of CNC machine operations, programming, and applications in modern manufacturing. This course covers the fundamentals of CNC technology, including machine structure, axis configuration, and tool selection. Students will learn how to write and interpret G-codes and M-codes, develop part programs for milling and turning operations, and simulate machining processes using industry-standard software. The course emphasizes hands-on training with CNC machines, enabling learners to gain practical experience in setup, operation, and troubleshooting. By the end of the program, participants will be capable of creating optimized CNC programs for various machining tasks, enhancing precision, efficiency, and productivity in manufacturing environments.

description:
Course Description:

The Software Testing and Quality Assurance is designed to equip learners with the skills and knowledge required to ensure high-quality software delivery. This program covers the complete software testing life cycle (STLC), including manual and automated testing methodologies, test case design, defect tracking, and quality assurance processes. Learners will gain hands-on experience with leading tools such as Selenium, JIRA, TestNG, and Postman, preparing them to detect bugs efficiently and improve overall software performance. By the end of this course, participants will be proficient in performing functional, regression, integration, and performance testing, aligning their expertise with industry best practices. Whether you are an aspiring tester or a professional looking to enhance your QA skills, this certification provides the foundation to build a successful career in software testing and quality assurance.
